Senior Frontend Engineer

Remote (US)

Trusted by more than 18,000 Shopify stores, Postscript gives ecommerce brands the tools they need to run a world-class SMS marketing program. We are hiring across our Messaging Channels team to build what comes next.

Primary duties

  • Build and maintain frontend experiences using React and TypeScript
  • Drive frontend architecture decisions and establish patterns that scale across the team
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code reviews and pairing

What We'll Love About You

  • 4+ years of professional experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience building complex, interactive UIs, rich workflows, editors, or data-heavy dashboards.

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Home office stipend

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $172,000 - $203,000 plus equity.

Equal Opportunity

Postscript is an equal opportunity employer.
